STYLE LOCK — Crystal Quest Painterly World Map.
Use the attached chapter-1-library-map.webp as the authoritative STYLE reference. Match its rendering, color relationships, material treatment, detail density and atmospheric depth, not its specific library building or geography.
Create a finely hand-painted premium fantasy mobile RPG world map. Use soft controlled painterly brush texture, delicate colored edges without black outlines, dimensional cream stone, naturally layered cliffs, nuanced lush foliage, tiny flowers and climbing ivy. Use warm sunlight, cool teal-violet shadows, golden paths, turquoise water where appropriate, blue atmospheric distance and softly billowing white clouds. Violet-blue crystals have translucent faceted surfaces, white highlights and restrained magical glow; gold is a restrained waypoint accent.
Use an elevated three-quarter map view, clear destination architecture, readable winding routes, crisp nearby terrain and softer lower-contrast distant scenery. Keep navigation landmarks distinct at portrait mobile size. The image must look like another region painted by the same artist as the style reference. Preserve the region's own subject and geography rather than copying the reference's buildings.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Wordoria Crystal Quest story world map.
Scene: World 10, The Observatory Where Starlight Stopped. A sunlit deep mountain canyon with old signal outposts, a broken observation bridge with visible lower maintenance passages and a small refuge, maintenance ladders, cream-stone signal terraces and a final observatory with a large crystal beacon and mirror arrays. NOT a library or castle. Narrative geography is viewed from elevated map perspective, but stage progression MUST run TOP TO BOTTOM: start with a small roadside guard post at the TOP, pass the broken bridge around the MIDDLE, reach the observatory at the BOTTOM. The destination observatory must be completely inside the frame. No figures or bosses drawn.
Reference roles: Image 1 = authoritative chapter-1-library-map.webp STYLE reference only.
Composition: very tall portrait 1024 x 3072, 1:3 aspect ratio, suitable for vertical scrolling, several staggered canyon terraces with a continuous golden downward winding road. Reserve right-middle canyon spur for a single optional branch. Every stage is visually separated and accessible along clearly connected paths.
Gameplay contract: exactly 43 distinct violet-blue crystal waypoints on gold-rimmed circular pedestals: 40 main-route stages plus three OPTIONAL branch waypoints. Main stage numbered order and normalized centers (numbers are instructions only, do NOT draw text): 1=(25%,4%); 2=(45%,6.2%); 3=(65%,8.4%); 4=(78%,10.6%); 5=(60%,12.8%); 6=(40%,15%); 7=(22%,17.2%); 8=(42%,19.4%); 9=(25%,21.6%); 10=(45%,23.8%); 11=(65%,26%); 12=(78%,28.2%); 13=(60%,30.4%); 14=(40%,32.6%); 15=(22%,34.8%); 16=(42%,37%); 17=(25%,39.2%); 18=(45%,41.4%); 19=(65%,43.6%); 20=(56%,45.8%); 21=(60%,48%); 22=(40%,50.2%); 23=(22%,52.4%); 24=(42%,54.6%); 25=(25%,56.8%); 26=(45%,59%); 27=(65%,61.2%); 28=(78%,63.4%); 29=(60%,65.6%); 30=(40%,67.8%); 31=(22%,70%); 32=(42%,72.2%); 33=(25%,74.4%); 34=(45%,76.6%); 35=(65%,78.8%); 36=(78%,81%); 37=(60%,83.2%); 38=(40%,85.4%); 39=(22%,87.6%); 40=(52%,91%).
Stage 20 at broken bridge maintenance landing is the Lumen boss arena; stage 40 at the observatory entrance is the Seiran boss arena. Show these two as somewhat larger landing spaces. After stage 20, create ONE fork: main road continues downward toward stage 21; a separate short spur leads DOWN and RIGHT across exactly three extra crystal pedestals at (82%,48%),(88%,52%),(84%,57%), ending at a little isolated disused signal relay pavilion as optional side-story boss arena. The spur is a dead end and must not merge into or cross main route later. These 3 pedestals are additional to the 40 main pedestals. Build the paths and landings around all centers. Keep every waypoint separate and unobscured. No extra waypoint pedestals.

Avoid coarse low-poly geometry, chunky toy-like 3D rendering, plastic surfaces, flat oversaturated green terrain, black cartoon outlines, pixel art, gritty photorealism, muddy dark palettes, excessive bloom and repetitive noisy detail. No characters, monsters, text, letters, numbers, UI, labels, logos, watermark, frames or black side borders. Do not obscure the route or waypoint crystals with foliage, clouds or effects. Do not introduce buildings or narrative elements unrelated to the requested world.
